stage2_emission_geometry.instrument: Six-fold spatially blocked holdout; H-D detector fields held fixed; matched mass; only emission geometry varied.
stage2_emission_geometry.stage: Stage 2 only, before applying the Stage-1 prior.
stage2_emission_geometry.interpretation: A repository-recorded metric-geometry result, not a geological-hypothesis result, hidden-test prediction, or organizer score. Treat as an unreplicated holdout lead until rerun from restored inputs.

stage1_prior.stage: Stage 1 is reported separately; these values are not merged into the Stage-2-only sweep above.

secondary_h_m.interpretation: The cross-scale H-M model beats the older isotropic H-D baseline but not the later recorded H-D trace-emission result. It is a separate model arm, not evidence that the Stage-1 budget caused improvement.

artifact_review.decision: Do not reissue or relabel the archived maps. The packaged Stage-1-weighted artifacts are not the Stage-2-only holdout leader; the matching un-gated best was not freshly built or verified here. Restore the required training/prepared inputs, rerun the registered holdout and promotion gates, then build a new file with the current guarded writer.
